title: validate_ipv6_transport_lengths relies on caller for version check; self-check packet[0]>>4 == 6
description: P3 hardening, found by worker5 subagent correctness pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk. lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c:453-472 reads packet[4..5] and packet[6] without validating packet[0]>>4 == 6; correctness depends entirely on the single caller lichen_schc_compress short-circuiting at schc.c:542 (pkt_len < IPV6_HDR_LEN || ipv6_version(packet) != 6). Python (packet.py:116-117 IPv6Header.from_bytes) and Rust (codec.rs:275 validate_full_ipv6_structure) both validate version INSIDE the validator. The guard pkt_len >= IPV6_HDR_LEN exists (:465-467, closing bead nyx7's OOB) but the version check is missing. validate_ipv6_header_chain is static with one guarded call site today, so no live bug - contract hardening so the validator is self-defending like the references. Fix: add version != 6 -> SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE at the top of validate_ipv6_transport_lengths; cover with a direct-call unit test in lichen/tests/schc/main.c (which also discharges the missing-test part of bead project-LICHEN-worker6-nyx7 if folded there).
